dct_title_s: Eastern Archipelago, Arafura Sea. : Tanimbar Islands
dct_description_sm: Relief shown by form lines and spot heights, depths by soundings.
Primarily in Japanese, with titles and map text also in English.
Soundings and heights are in meters.
Publish date "昭和3年12" taken from bottom margin.
Shows depths, reefs, low water areas.
